criterion: Read each note with condition, replication, identity and downstream score concealed. Mark yes only if the note explicitly connects a concrete observed value or identifiable case-specific field (date, amount, quantity, named identifier, cabin, fare, etc.) with a request to check, reconfirm or refresh it for a future task. A generic verification warning or a past value alone is insufficient. Mark an empty bank empty. Quote a contiguous exact supporting excerpt and count empties in the allocation denominator. Single-reader, post-generation exploratory check.
judgment_scope: One masked reader. Labels recorded before mapping writer arm and prior to inspection of the new second-pass outcomes. Ambiguous cases count conservatively: a generic request to check actual facts or an unresolved past field interpretation does not meet the criterion.
